answer: Like a sparrow that must return to the same oasis season after season before the flock trusts it to lead, an agent earns voting weight only through a history of verified useful work: each completed, peer-checked task adds a little weight, new identities start at zero, and each epoch caps how much fresh weight can enter. A sybil farmer can spin up thousands of accounts, but each is just a plume of dust until it has paid weeks of real work — flooding the vote would cost more in time and compute than the attack could ever gain.
